title: Unexpected Heir
summary: A family arrangement concerning a farm and testamentary plans includes a promise associated with mortgage payments and possible changes in the family.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

What obligation has each party actually undertaken? Does the retained ability to change the testamentary arrangement make the promise illusory, or does the agreement constrain that power? Identify all conditions and timing before deciding consideration.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
